caption_txt.title: Your Occupation Isn't on the NSW Skills List? Check Again! 🔍
body: Can't find your occupation on the NSW skills list? Check carefully. NSW doesn't publish individual occupation codes. It publishes unit groups, and each unit group covers several occupations. For example, the Advertising and Marketing Professionals unit group includes marketing specialists and content creators. The same goes for Other Engineering Professionals, and for Sports Coaches, Instructors and Officials, which covers tennis and cricket coaches.
If your occupation falls under one of these unit groups, our Registered Migration Agent Rahul Dhanda (MARN 2418640) and the PFEC team can assess your profile and walk you through your options.
